claude.notes: --setting-sources '' isolates the call from the operator's own plugins, hooks, memory, and output styles. Without it, a user-level always-on flag (~/.claude/.tldr-always) would inject the tldr ruleset into the BASELINE condition and the eval would measure the skill against itself. --model is pinned deliberately: without a pin the eval silently runs whatever the operator or the CLI release defaults to, so the model varies between operators and over time, and per-token cost varies with it.

codex.notes: --ignore-user-config --ephemeral is the Codex equivalent of the isolation above. Keep it.

gemini.notes: Gemini CLI loads GEMINI.md from the working directory. Run this harness from a directory that does not contain one, or the context file leaks into every condition.
